name: ml-company-formation
description: Mali company formation and entity-choice research draft for 2026, built from the identified OHADA 2014 company Act, OHADA 2010 commercial Act, Mali's 2015 SARL capital law and official administrative guidance. Use it to prepare a conditional SARL or SA formation workpaper, distinguish an individual trader from an incorporated company, reconcile subscribed and paid capital, assemble registration evidence and plan annual accounts approval and auditor tests. It corrects the old confusion between total SARL capital and nominal share value. Two executable cases check capital funding and the audit-threshold boundary. Complete later national amendments, current fees, agency forms and authenticated filing remain unproved; this is not approval to incorporate or a professional attestation.
